repos_data.description: Cross Origin Resource Sharing ( CORS ) support for Flask
A lightning-fast, simple CORS proxy server written in Go. Deploy anywhere with one click!

Pronounced "HTTP" - because sometimes the best fucking code comes with wordplay. A Go library that does everything you need and nothing you don't. Spin up a production-ready server with middleware, WebSocket hubs, file uploads, static serving, request proxying with caching, and OpenAPI validation.
Paste a developer error, get the real cause and the fix. Offline, zero-dependency explainers for CORS, ESM/CJS, npm ERESOLVE, ChunkLoadError, Postgres/Supabase DATABASE_URL and Next.js build errors.
